It’s hard not to be a hypocrite. Everyone ends up being one occasionally. For the most part, we start acting like someone else or trying to be something we are not. We say one thing and do something else. We try to impress our friends, hide things from our parents, go along with the crowd, and even show off. Sometimes our bad behavior doesn’t look so bad when we are around people with worse behavior. Our odor, while awful, doesn’t “smell” so bad because those around us are much worse!

The secret to character—and the true measure of any hypocrite—is how you act when you are alone. You can tell who you truly are when you are by yourself and no one else can see you—when it is just God and you alone. How you act when you are by yourself speaks volumes about your character. Are you honest? Do you hold yourself accountable? Are you the same person alone as with other people? If someone were watching, would you be proud of your actions?

Be a person of character first when you are by yourself, and then when you are around other people it will be much easier.

7.title: Minimum Requirement
7.verse: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself up for her.
7.quote: Whether they give or refuse, it delights women just the same to have been asked.
7.wisdom:
There are lots of sections on women/girls. Who better to give you advice than another man? Actually, who better to give you advice than your Dad? Here are the minimum requirements for both the girls you date and ultimately, the woman you marry someday.

Minimum requirement 1: Treat them like a "queen".

I cannot emphasize how important it is that when you date someone you need to treat them like a queen. This means all the basics; open their door, pull out their chair, tell them they look nice, pay for their meals, etc. This is the only way to treat a woman. There is no “style” that says you treat them “standoffish”, “play it cool”, etc. If you do these type of things it makes you look selfish, self-absorbed and totally focused on yourself. It may work in the movies but it does not work in real life.

"Like a queen" means they are precious, special, respected, cared for, protected when necessary, and most important owned by God and should be treated as such. It isn’t hard to recognize when you do it. They will see it immediately as well.

I get sometimes “playing hard to get” but that is not how you treat them. It doesn’t work with any woman that has confidence and self-esteem. Women talk.

If you want to have an opportunity to date a lot of women; treat them like queens.

8.title: The Perfect College Day
8.verse: There is an appointed time for everything. And there is a time for every event under heaven.
8.quote: Half our life is spent trying to find something to do with the time we have rushed through life trying to save.
8.wisdom:
There are 24 hours in a day. Here is what a successful college student figures out prior to going to school:

A Perfect College Day:
Sleep — 8 hours
School — 3 hours
Eating — 3 hours
Studying — 3 hours
Everything else — 7 hours
Total — 24 hours

If you can figure this out early enough, college will be a very successful experience. You are given 24 hours each day and if you can discipline yourself to get enough sleep, and make sure you study every day you will do amazingly well. Managing your time is huge in college. Seven hours is an enormous amount of time each day to have fun, work, hang out, etc. The change from high school is pretty alarming.

Your ability to be focused in an environment of freedom is a challenging adjustment. I made sure that I went to the library and studied there. Every time I tried to study in my dorm I would get distracted. We also had a dorm study hall area that worked as well.

Study every day and you will be surprised how well you do in every other part of college.

9.title: Words
9.verse: A soft answer turns away wrath but a harsh word stirs up anger
9.quote: The difference between the almost right word and the right word is really a large matter-ʻtis the difference between the lightning-bug and the lightning.
9.wisdom:
For some reason, the older you get the more important your words become. As a kid, you get a lot more leeway in what you say to people. Sometimes the fact that you are a teenager allows you to “get away” with comments that are passed off as being just something a teenager would say. When you are an adult those words aren’t as easily passed by and, more importantly, the responsibility for what you say and do changes. As an adult, you are responsible for not only your actions, but also your words. This means that a complaint, criticism, feeling, or even just an opinion holds more weight as an 18-year old than it does as a 17-year old.

I encourage you to begin now to measure your comments and thoughts when you speak, especially to those you love. Your sister really listens to you. Kind and unkind comments from you penetrate deeply to her. In fact, what you say to your mom and me also cuts deeply. Be aware of what you are saying and why. So many people hurt others or get hurt by unkind, flippant words that with just a little extra care and maturity could have been avoided.

10.title: I am Proud of You
10.verse: That is my commandment that You love one another as I have loved you.
10.quote: To love is to receive a glimpse of heaven.
10.wisdom:
I am really proud of you in so many ways. It has been so much fun to watch you grow up. I am looking forward to being even more proud of you as an adult. It is going to be a privilege to watch you now that you are a man. I know it sounds corny but you have such potential to be a godly man that changes the world. You are talented, gifted and I respect you.I know you are a man but please have patience with me. <mark>I still see the little kid with a runny nose and chili bowl haircut.</mark>

You won't get how much I love you until you have your own kids. Then you will get it. This is supposed to be 52 things you need to know. This one is simple:

I love you VERY VERY much!

11.title: Healthy Eating
11.verse: For do you not know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you whom you have from God, and you are not your own.
11.quote: Outside of every fat man there was even a fatter man trying to close in.
11.wisdom:
1 Corinthians 6:19

Outside of every fat man there was even a fatter man trying to close in. Kingsley Amis

“You are what you eat.” Kind of a corny saying but it really is true. <mark>What may have at times seemed a little crazy by us with all the focus on nutrition, labels, proteins, etc. will actually be one of the very best gifts you have ever received.</mark> An understanding of nutrition and health will benefit you, your friends and ultimately your future wife and family.

You need to recognize that the body you have is the only one you will ever have. If you treat it poorly it will come back to haunt you. You need to put quality fuel into it. That means vegetables, etc. If you don’t you will have problems. When you are young parents are supposed to help protect you from yourself. Your metabolism will change. It gets harder as you get older.

<mark>Slow down on the cokes, fried food, fast food and put in some water, vegetables and fruit. You will be shocked how much better it is for you.</mark>

As you know all this great information when used for good is great. Just remember that exercise, eating healthy, getting plenty of sleep all add up to a “body” that you can use to pursue all your dreams and goals. The other corny saying is “it’s what is on the inside that matters not the outside”. Also, true. Be focused on staying in great shape and looking good. Just do not go overboard.

Just sayin...if we would focus the same amount of time on our heart; as our muscles and abs; we would all be just fine.

12.title: Money
12.verse: Whoever loves money will never have enough money Whoever loves wealth will not be satisfied with it. This is also useless
12.quote: Lack of money is no real obstacle; lack of an idea is an obstacle.
12.wisdom:
One of things that a man I worked for taught me made a difference. One day he said to me; “Why do you choose to be poor?” I didn’t have a really good answer so I told him that I didn’t choose to be poor. He said based on how hard I worked and what job I was doing, I was choosing to be poor.

That always seemed a little harsh. Not everyone works for money. Poor in money does not mean poor in spirit, poor in friends, or poor in anything else. How much you make will never matter if you have a healthy perspective of money. Money does make a difference and there is something to learn from his comments.

What I have learned since then is that a lot of people, who are much dumber than I am, make a lot more money than I do. Conversely, there are hundreds of thousands of people, who are A LOT smarter than I am, that don’t make as much as I do. Making money is a choice. I always felt like it was a really effective way to keep score. It is not the only way to keep score, but it was one way to keep score. I also made a commitment that when I left a company, it was either going to be in a sea of red ink (losses) or black ink (profits), but never in handcuffs.

That is a pretty good business principle to live by.

13.title: Communication with Women
13.verse: My lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will utter no deceit.
13.quote: Love is a promise, love is a souvenir, once given never forgotten, never let it disappear.
13.wisdom:
Women want to communicate. They have a desire to connect through communication. Women share their feelings and feel connected when you share your feelings. The movies talk about the “strong and silent” type. That is only to the outside world.

Any relationship you have is going to be based on how often and how deep you communicate. What is amazing is that you are a great communicator. You really are. The challenge is that sometimes you only communicate if you feel like it. You can’t meet women, date women and really have a solid relationship unless you open up and communicate with them. I encourage to work on this. You can start by opening up more with *your mom, sister, me etc.*

When you communicate make an effort to edify or lift up. People like to hear nice things about themselves. Being a person that sees the best in people, finds the glass half full is the type of man you want to be. There is another benefit: it will also get you more dates and more important more second dates!

14.title: Alcohol, Drugs and Tobacco
14.verse: Wine and beer make people loud and controlled It is not wise to get drunk on them.
14.quote: There are two things that will be believed of any man whatsoever, and one of them is that he has taken to drink.
14.wisdom:
Don’t drink and drive. I know it sounds simple but don’t. Don’t ride with other people who are drinking. I did both and it is by the sheer grace of God that I am alive. If just one time something had gone wrong it would have wrecked my life and others. You will get the chance. Don't do it. The risk is too high.

Two more comments about alcohol, drugs, and cigarettes for you. Obviously, stay away from them. Hopefully, up to now you have. Beware that you really can’t know if you have an addictive behavior until it is too late. They say that some people become addicted quicker than others do. If you stay away, you never have the risk of being addicted. That is one of the reasons I never really drank coffee. I know that one cup of coffee a day is not bad for you. I just never liked the concept of people saying they were “addicted” to caffeine. I just didn’t want to have any addiction.

Sometimes with alcohol or drugs you get addicted not to the substance but how you think you look when you are doing it. I remember kids thinking they were funnier or cooler when they did them. They weren’t. They just looked stoned or drunk. They were funny but not a respectful funny. Don’t be fooled by people saying: “You are a cool drunk or funnier when you are drunk.” They aren’t really helping you.

Abuse of all these is just plain harmful and a slippery slope that you could spend the rest of your life fighting if you let it have control. This is especially true of cigarettes. I have seen way too many smart people still smoking because they can’t stop.

15.title: The Only Measurement
15.verse: Wisdom begins with respect for the Lord Those who obey his orders have good understanding He should be praised forever.
15.quote: It ain't those parts of the Bible that I can't understand that bother me, it's the parts that I do understand.
15.wisdom:
Jesus Christ is the only answer when there are no answers, but also when there are answers. Don’t measure your decisions, actions, attitudes, career choices, or spousal selection against anything else but Him. If you remember that He is the model, you cannot go wrong. As soon as you depend on a human (including yourself), you will get let down sometime, somewhere. I am great example of that. I can parade past you ten people that will tell you how wonderful I am in comparison to others they know. You know, and I know, my past sins. While an example in some areas, I fall very, very short. For whatever it is worth, so does everyone else, even if you can’t see it.

You fall short too. Right now, you are blessed and you have the whole world in front of you. The need for Jesus may not seem as strong or necessary. Trust me. You need Him. He is the only real help you can count on for the rest of your life. Learn that while the sun is shining, rather than while it is raining.

Life was meant to be lived His way. There are other ways, but they are not as rewarding or as exciting.

16.title: Marry a Godly Women
16.verse: What I am telling you is good, So do not forget what I teach you.
16.quote: It is very difficult to live among people you love and hold back from offering them advice.
16.wisdom:
You know this.

I will say it anyway. Marry a Godly woman. This requires you to date Godly women first. If you don’t start right you won’t finish right. This means ask them if they are Christians. I know that not all Christian girls are perfect. There may be kids I have seen or met that have totally fooled me and are the worst behaved and acting people around. We don’t lack hypocrites in this world in any area.

Don’t let one or two or ten bad examples dispel that fact that you want to keep looking for Christian women to have in your life.

To get there ask two simple questions:

1. What is your story on how you met Christ? You know the right answer. It isn’t “I go to church, I was baptized as a child, I’m a Methodist/Catholic, etc.”

2. Tell me where you worship today? You know the right answer here as well. You are looking for someone who is bearing fruit, active in their church, etc. (Note: Another great sign is if they ask you the same questions!)

I know you want to marry someone you can respect and admire. Make sure she is Godly. When you do that, you will know that she is relying on someone other than herself. Just because she is beautiful or smart doesn’t mean she will treat you and your kids well. I do know that if she loves the Lord there is no guarantee either. However, if she loves the Lord then there is always hope that if she does stray she will come back to the Lord. That is something you can count on. If you both rely on God there will be no questions that don’t have an answer and no problem that can’t be solved. It requires both of you to have a common belief and a common hope.

To get a Godly women; you must be a Godly man.

17.title: Money is a tool
17.verse: The more wealth people have The more friends they have to help spend it. So what do people really gain? They gain nothing except to look at their riches.
17.quote: A wise man should have money in his head; not in his heart.
17.wisdom:
Money is a tool. You work to live, not live to work. Any other concept regarding money will only cause pain and heartache someday. Money does not make you better or worse. It does not buy happiness; it can only buy you a feeling of financial security. Knowing you are not going to the poor house is nice, but it won’t fulfill your life.

Be open with your money. Give it to God, your family, friends and people and causes in need. Do it in that order. If you grip it too tight you will lose it or worse, spend your entire life trying not to lose it. Money is not important. It is serious, but it is not important.

18.title: I Love you Anyway
18.verse: Love patiently accepts all things. It always trusts, Always hopes, and always remains strong.
18.quote: Love and a cough cannot be hid.
18.wisdom:
I love you. They are the most powerful words on earth. For many people they are like oxygen. Love is a choice not a feeling. It is an action we take to “love someone” right where they are. I saw a skit at Fellowship Church; maybe you remember it? They said:

**Wrong:** I love you BECAUSE...you love me, you behave, you are smart, pretty, and you don’t talk back with me.

**Wrong:** I love you IF... you love me, you get good grades, you agree with me, you don’t get fat, etc.

**Right:** I love you ANYWAY. No matter what. There is nothing you can make me do to stop loving you.

Make sure that when you love; you choose to love ANYWAY. Otherwise, it is really complicated and awfully disappointing for those you love and those that love you.

Make sure you tell people, all the time. It makes a big difference. It doesn’t matter if you are mad or angry. You can still love people that you are mad or angry with; it just may be a little bit harder.

19.title: Crying
19.verse: His anger lasts only a moment But His kindness lasts for a lifetime Crying may last a night But joy comes in the morning.
19.quote: Those who do not feel pain; seldom think it is felt
19.wisdom:
CRYING

I only saw my Dad cry once and that was at the cemetery when his Dad died. It was the first time that I had ever seen him cry. It was pretty strange. He may have cried prior to that time but I don’t remember it. My mom cried when I was younger. Not a good day for me if I was the one that caused it...

You have seen me cry. I expect to cry at your sister's wedding (not sure about yours...) and most definitely when you have kids. I boo-hoo pretty easily at sad movies and I can be a faucet more often at happy and joyful moments. Guys have a tendency to try and hide it. We are idiots. Why all the crying talk? I guess I just want you to hear from a “guy” how healthy it is too feel so strongly about things and events in your life (good or bad) that it makes you want to cry.

I have seen you cry lots of times. Don’t try and stop the water works anywhere in life (except maybe at work. If it is possible-and it isn’t always possible- this would be the only place, I wouldn’t cry). Keep on crying for joy! It is also important that you grieve when there is loss. Not forever, so it controls your life, but grieve. With Christ’s strength you will get through it. Experience all that God has for you in every type of emotion.

For “cryin-out-loud”…keep the tears flowing.

20.title: "Old" Friends
20.verse: A faithful friend is the medicine of life
20.quote: In prosperity our friends know us; in adversity we know our friends.
20.wisdom:
Friends are huge in your life. They can have a dramatic impact on who you are and what you do. You have heard all of the recommendations you want about “If you hang around with trash…you will start to smell like it,” etc.

I am really partial to my high school friends because I have known them for so long. I don’t really have a lot in common (different states, jobs, hobbies etc.) with most of them other than my childhood. I really like that connection. Most of the time when we get together it is to talk about old times. To laugh and joke about the dumb things we did, said, or thought. I really, really like those memories and I love talking with them.

Stay close to all of your former friends if you can, even if you rarely get to see them. Sometimes it is just fun to get together and talk about how you “used to be friends.” You don’t have to replace them; they just become old friends that for the most part you talk about “old things.” I watch you with Tyler and Taylor and you seem to have already started this process.

Some twenty years from now maybe you will be in touch with some of your old friends or maybe you won’t. When you do see them, you can still have fun and for that time, you can still be close friends.

21.title: Relationship with Christ
21.verse: For he looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under heaven.
21.quote: "I do not feel obliged to believe that the same God who has endowed us with sense, reason, and intellect has intended us to forgo their use."
21.wisdom:
Well here we are. You are now on your own. <mark>You are going to Christian College, even right smack in the middle of the bible belt.</mark> Yet you are still on your own. Yes, we will watch and hope and pray for a Godly son. The relationship is now one to one: Just you and Jesus. No Dad/Mom to force you to go to church, pray, find bible verses, etc. Just you and God. The reality is that despite our overseeing it has been you and God all along. I know He doesn’t completely measure you by how well you behave when we force you to do something. He always measures your heart and attitude in every situation.

Here are things a Godly man does:

Tithes his income. We have asked/forced you in the past. Tithe; you will be blessed.

Spends time each day in prayer not only for himself but more importantly for others. <mark>Do you pray for your Mom, me, sister, or others?</mark> Do you thank God for how blessed you are ( health, financial, smarts, looks)? You should.

Personal time in the Bible- Not just for school; just because you want to learn more and have a relationship with the creator of the world.

Serving others- Not just because you have to but because you want to please Him.

Line in the sand: For movies, books, relationships, etc. Not just to look good but because you know it makes Him proud of you.

What comes out of your mouth: Don’t use the Lord’s name in vain, Godly words in content and tone.

No one is watching you anymore...Just you and Him....

22.title: Lying
22.verse: If you respect the Lord, you will also hate evil I hate pride, bragging, evil ways and lies
22.quote: A liar needs a good memory.
22.wisdom:
You have probably read a zillion articles on this subject. Just some simple thoughts:

Tell the truth because it is the easiest thing to remember.

One of my favorite lines from a movie is “You can’t handle the truth.” Some people can’t. If it doesn’t edify or correct in love; it is not necessary to always tell somebody something even if it is the “truth.” That is not lying. It is being kind. (Example of someone saying: You are fat and you need to lose weight!”)

Don’t lie to yourself. This one will do the most damage. The 12 step programs for drinking, drugs, etc. have a step and I think it is step number 1. This step basically says to “get out of the denial stage” which means that you quit lying to yourself.

Lies are more damaging with time. They get worse. Remember that people always lie. Someone once said to “Believe half of what you see and NOTHING of what you hear." Just because you read it, or hear it, doesn’t make it true.

The next time you call someone a liar, or complain that they lie, remember it probably has not been very long since you lied. If this is not an area where you struggle, consider yourself fortunate.

23.title: Pornography
23.verse: God wants you to be holy and to stay away from sexual sins.
23.quote: All sins are attempts to fill voids.
23.wisdom:
I am not usually one to declare many things from Satan but this is one of them. Pornography is like a disease. There may be worse addictions that can kill you but this one is a slow and painful death. Pornography is a massive addiction in this country especially for men. I promise you if you have not already figured it out; you can be sucked in by this disease. I cannot tell you how many men I know that have been, can be or will be sucked in by pornography.

I know this because it can suck me in. When I make a mistake ( Note: Let me be clear there have been times when I did not make a “mistake” and just went to sites I should not have gone to on the web) and find myself at a sight I am not supposed to be on; I can hear the drumbeat literally of Satan saying "click another page see what’s there, go a little farther". I wish I could tell you that pornography does not affect me but it does and like most men I have to consciously make a decision to stay away from it.

For men it just seems natural and a “guy thing” that we would want to see naked, gorgeous women etc. The problem is that it is degrading to women ( when you have a daughter you will really get it.) and just bad all the way around.. It really does eat at your brain and puts all sorts of bad images and expectations in your mind. The ultimate problem is that it takes a good thing: “Seeing your wife naked, having sex, etc.” and turns it from something you do and enjoy into something dirty that you watch. <mark>It drives men to “masturbate” to fake and unreal women rather than find a great and godly relationship and actually living real life. (Note: That was pretty straight forward!)</mark>

Some guys use it as a sick thing with women. There is a very short distance for the majority of people between the really sick stuff and just some women with their tops off. It is an addiction and just gets worse.

The only solution is to keep it out of your brain to begin with from the very start. If you let it in then real women are degraded, they can’t be as perfect and you become attracted to pictures and people that are not real.

Pornography has no place in a relationship; married or otherwise.

24.title: Gossip
24.verse: And besides they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house, and not only idle but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
24.quote: No one gossips about other peoples secret virtues.
24.wisdom:
The reality is that I have experienced, and I’m sure you have too, the negative effect of gossip. It is really damaging to all parties involved. David Boenker says there are three types of class of people (He didn’t mean money.)

Lowest class: Talks about other people

Middle class: Talks about themselves

Upper class: Talks about ideas and vision

People who gossip usually do so because they want and need someone to compare themselves to so they can feel better about themselves. Someone else’s misery in a weird way makes their problems not seem so bad.

This is one of many of the subjects that I tell you one thing and then invariably I may do something else. I don’t have a large problem with gossip because I usually don’t have much to gossip about with anyone. There are certainly times when I get some information and it is hard not to pass it on. Sadly, that is gossip. I am sure you are challenged as well.

Don’t be a gossip as an adult.

25.title: Memories
25.verse: I will forgive them for the wicked things they did And I will not remember their sins anymore.
25.quote: Not the power to remember, but it’s very opposite, the power to forget, is a necessary condition of our existence.
25.wisdom:
Your memory is not as good as you think it is. This is a tough lesson to learn but a reality of life that when learned makes it easier. I have found that I remember how bad the “bad” things were, yet I don’t always remember the good things. At the same time, the bad has a tendency to look worse in the rear view mirror and I have a hard time remembering the circumstances and all the other things that were a part of my memory.

There are so many things that I have forgotten over the years. Some forever, and some things I remember only after something or someone reminds me of it. I cherish the memories that I have because sometimes it is all I have of the past. Many people live their life with some sort of baggage that is related to a bad memory. They can’t remember the whole thing or they just remember parts of it. What they do remember can hold them hostage for life. This isn’t always a bad memory. Sometimes they are good ones that can hold us hostage. Some people "peak" in high school and never want to leave that period of their life. You know them: the football star, the girl that always had a boyfriend in high school when no one else did, guy with the coolest car.

Make sure as you move forward that you don’t rely on just your memory of things. Many things that happened to you as a child you remember through the eyes of a child. Sometimes that is good and sometimes it is bad. Use the other people around you to get a better perspective, or at least a different perspective, on the situation. Ask all the people around you what they thought of a situation. You know that everyone’s opinion will always be different.

That is the case if you just ask someone about something that happened last week! What it teaches you is that there is more that happened, and you don’t have that memory.

If you ask others, you can gain more perspective.

It will keep you out of bondage for both good and bad memories that can hold you back from being all God would want you to be.

26.title: Things I Remember
26.verse: You gave me life and showed me kindness And in your care you watched over my life.
26.quote: Life can only be understood backwards, But it must be lived forwards.
26.wisdom:
You were a very cute kid.

You were a better soccer goalie than you give yourself credit for. I know you were terrified but you had good hands and natural ability.

You have a great sense of humor.

Your relationship with Christine is special. Don’t lose it. Help it grow. It is okay to love your sister and be close to her.

You really do have a very pretty baseball swing.

You are very smart. Use the gift you have.

You are an amazing listener. That will make you great at friendships, business and marriage.

You will only have one brother in-law. Get to know him.

The sky for you is the limit if you choose to pursue life with passion. Go for it.

I loved watching you play every sport. I enjoyed watching you play hockey just as much as watching you play baseball.

27.title: New College Friends
27.verse: Some friends may ruin you but a real friend will be more loyal than a brother.
27.quote: The only reward of virtue is virtue; the only way to have a friend is to be one.
27.wisdom:
They are a reflection of who you are and what you do. We can’t live without friends and if we pick the wrong ones we may not live at all. Pick great friends and be a great friend to others. We have told you to seek out Christian friends.

Friends are with you through good and bad. Friends know you and accept you just the way you are. Friends are willing to correct you when necessary but always letting you understand that they love you just the same. College will give you the opportunity to add new friends. Pick very, very wisely. Friends will influence you. Make sure it is a good influence. You will meet a lot of people who have grown up in a different environment than you. Some better and some worse. Make sure that your friends are going to build you up and bring you joy, and that you do the same for them.

Everyone at one time or another in his or her life experiences a friend that is not good for them. You know it but you have let them get close to you and it becomes hard to let go. Don’t get sucked in by people who look like they have “experienced” more bad things than you and they are better off for it. They aren’t. If it was wrong and dangerous, they haven’t “lived more” than you; they just dodged a bullet and got away with it. Maybe they won’t next time and you won’t “dodge the bullet” the first time. Can you live with the consequences, and secondly, do you want to live with the consequences? Life is dangerous enough without courting new problems.

Let go of bad friends. Better yet, don’t start with them. You will be better off in the short and long run. I would love to get to know your new friends as you get older. That would have been somewhat weird when you were under 18. Now it is cool.

28.title: Abortion
28.verse: Before I made you in your mother’s womb, I chose you Before you were born, I set you apart for a special work I appointed you as a prophet to the nations.
28.quote: There is one thing alone That stands the brunt of life throughout its course; A quiet conscience.
28.wisdom:
I have met about four women who have had abortions. You actually know some of them even though you couldn’t tell. They live with a sorrow and pain that cannot be described. They “killed” their own flesh and blood. I also know people (you do as well) who had kids when they were 15 years old. Another had one when she was 17. They gave them up for adoption. While they regret getting in trouble early in life, they have no regrets that these kids are alive today. No burden, no damage just the knowledge that because they made a mistake they didn’t make two and end up living with the fact that someone else had to die because of their mistake.

This doesn’t mean that there aren’t people out there that say they weren’t impacted negatively by having an abortion. I don’t know any and quite frankly I can’t imagine how they were not impacted over the course of their life.

Sometimes people justify it because the “man” wanted it to happen or didn’t want to have any responsibility. Don't be that man. A child’s life is far more important than yours or any other man's embarrassment, reputation, parents, etc.

Abortion is an easy short-term solution with hard long term consequences. Having a child and giving it up for adoption is a really hard short-term solution with really great long-term consequences. I am not telling you this just for you. I want you to save yourself for your wife (see other topic) but I also want you to give good advice if you are ever presented with the opportunity to help someone. In the unlikely situation that you ever end up in this situation yourself, I hope you would heed this advice as well.

29.title: The Bible
29.verse: All scripture is given by God and is useful for teaching, for Showing people what is wrong in their lives, for correcting faults And for teaching how to live right.
29.quote: You can learn more about human nature by reading the Bible than by living in New York
29.wisdom:
It really is pretty sad that I have spent so much time dispensing advice to you and expecting that you will read it. The reality is that you will be far better off if you put this list down and just read the Bible. That goes for everything I say and everything that all the men and women of earth have said as well (including you!). We fall so short with our miniscule perspectives on things.

At 18, you have seen virtually nothing in this world, I have seen twice as much as you, and I know nothing as well.

Two people were talking and one person said there was no God. After arguing back and forth for a while one man took out a paper plate and said to the other, “Imagine that all of the world’s knowledge is represented by this paper plate. Everything that could ever be known in and about this world is on this plate. How much of this plate do you think represents what you know of this world? The guy took a pen and made a tiny dot on the plate. The questioner responded, “Don’t you think there just may be some information that you don’t know that might make you wrong?”

I appreciate you reading these and I know that you love me. That gives me an opportunity to share with you some of my life lessons. It’s all garbage compared to what God has to say. I hope that my advice just follows His. I know that intellectually you know that to be true. I just wanted to make sure that I said it and to make sure that you knew that I recognized it as well.

30.title: Anger
30.verse: Don’t get angry, Don’t be upset; it only leads to trouble
30.quote: Anger is never without an argument But seldom with a good one.
30.wisdom:
You have heard this a million times and you will probably hear it a million more times. Holding on to anger buys you nothing. Staying angry and holding grudges only hurts you far more than it does the other person or thing you are angry about. I repeat it just because if you don’t get this, it can control you and can control your life. Smart, intelligent, successful, bright, and creative people have been strangled by anger and grudges.

You have had a lot of practice at this over the years. As a divorced kid you have been given the unfortunate opportunity to have things to be angry about or hold grudges. You didn’t have any more than anyone else (things to be angry about). Everyone probably has the same amount; it is just that yours were more “socially okay” to hold onto. Everyone can feel your pain and understand if you are angry with your mom, dad, stepparent, etc. Today’s society gives much more latitude for this.

Problems from childhood, and tough circumstances can be used as crutches and excuses. People near you, and even those who love you, will always “cut you some slack” for your past. Therapists and counselors drive BMW’s and Mercedes because of it. It is socially acceptable to be angry with an ex-spouse, parent or stepparent, etc., for a lifetime, if you choose. The problem is that social acceptance just makes it harder to get rid of it, and getting rid of it is the only survival plan you can have.

There are even people that use the “anger” and say that it helps drive them to be better or makes them focus more. That is a load of crap. It doesn’t help anyone under any circumstances, and there are far better ways to get motivated.

31.title: Treating your Mom with Respect
31.verse: A wise son makes his father happy But a foolish son disrespects his mother.
31.quote: An injury is much sooner forgotten than an insult.
31.wisdom:
If there is one area where I would like to see you continue and even improve as an adult, it would be treating your Mom with respect and honoring her. You need to treat everyone with respect including me. Your mom deserves, and has earned an extra measure of respect, as have all moms. (I think dads have as well, but I am the one writing this...) Obviously, it is one of the Ten Commandments.

A mother-child relationship is never perfect. It can’t be. You have two people separated by 20 some years with a passionate interest in the outcome of the “younger of the two”. Both believe they have earned the right and also are “right” about what to do. Honor your Mom with your words, thoughts and actions. She deserves it. Measure your words with her. She loves you and only wants the best for you. She isn’t perfect and I am not telling you to blindly respect each and every one of her actions or choices if you don’t. She would not want that either. I ask that you honor her and respect her because she is your mother. I also ask that you simply love her.

If you do that; the rest comes easy.

32.title: A Great Communicator
32.verse: "The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.
32.quote: Communication is not only the essence of being human, but also a vital property of life.
32.wisdom:
Communication is key to everything you do. It affects your relationships with your family, friends, work, school, you name it. In order to have the kind of success that you talk about you will have to be a great communicator. Whether you do it with few words or many words; communication is important.

There are many types of communication. Here are few that you will need to have be a great communicator.:

Respectful communication

Acknowledging people when they walk in the room. Recognizing someone’s feelings. Respectfully calling people back Looking people in the eye, strong hand shake, professional acknowledgement

Truthful Communication

Telling people the truth in love. That means not lying, avoiding an issue Communicating in love. Being kind with your words, not hurtful or mean. Telling people in a timely fashion when they need to know. Being a person who can keep a trust or secret from someone. Not being a gossip.

Loving communication

Telling the people you love that you do love them and care about them. Making the time and effort to connect with them. Being proactive and reaching out to those you love and those you want to love.

33.title: Treating the things you own...
33.verse: Those who have understanding will be given more And they will have all they need. But those who do not Have understanding, even what they have will be taken from them
33.quote: Property has its duties as well as it’s rights
33.wisdom:
I have enjoyed watching you and your car. You have taken pretty good care of it and it is evident that you value it by the way you take care of it. I can’t tell whether that is just when you are going to have a girl in it or whether you really are trying to take care of it. Do that with everything that you own. One of the signs of someone who is grateful and respectful of what they have been blessed with is how they take care of those things. Like everyone, I can do a much better job of this.

Sometimes I think because you have had so much that you really don’t appreciate it. I hope that is not the case. Be grateful and blessed with what you have. Make sure you at least understand what you have earned and what is by the sheer grace of God. Virtually everything you have (looks, money, house, family that loves you, car) was given to you and not earned. That makes you blessed and fortunate. Be humble about it and take care. You don’t want to lose it all in order to gain a lesson on how to appreciate it all. Don’t be the guy that only learns the lesson once it is all lost. That would be dumb and very, very painful. Learn the lesson and be thankful.

This means to take care of your car, clothes, house and body. I know your room isn’t perfect and mine isn’t either. Just remember that if you take care of things that you own, you will probably get an opportunity to own more things. In Christian speak this is called stewardship. It might be money, job, responsibility, kids, etc. Be a great steward.

34.title: Pornography II
34.verse: God knows who is evil and when he sees evil, he takes note of it.
34.quote: All sin tends to be addictive, and the terminal point of addiction is what is called damnation
34.wisdom:
Just a subject that requires a little more discussion. Pornography comes in many shapes and sizes. There is the web, magazines and “men’s clubs”. Stay out of those too. I am sure someday you will get invited to one. Hopefully you will say no. If you say yes, remember that most of the girls in there are some ones daughter, wife or girl friend. They may tell you it does not affect them or they just do it for the money but they are not telling the truth. Anyone that will take their clothes off in front of strange men and collect money from them has some serious problems.

I wish I could tell you that I have never been in one but I have. There is a large group of people that conduct business in these places and in many companies it is okay to do business there. Companies need to stop allowing their employees to use it for business.

It is another place that is not real. People pay women to have an interest in them for a short period of time. Men leave lots of money with women that have no interest in them but their money. They pay for attention. Men that get addicted to these places; and they do; end up paying for fake relationships and avoiding real ones. There is an old adage that when you go to a Men’s club you leave your money (with the girls and the place), the beer ( in the urinal) and most important the girls don’t come home with you either. So basically you leave with nothing.

35.title: Danger
35.verse: The Lord is like a strong tower Those who do right can run to him for safety
35.quote: Out of this nettle, danger We pluck this flower: safety.
35.wisdom:
The first place is always better than the second place...

I once heard a San Diego policeman tell us one time that if you are ever attacked by someone run immediately because the first place is always better than the second. This means that if they are going to hurt you in public they will do much worse things in private.

He gave examples of time and time again where people were talked into going to another place and ended up having more harm done to them. He even said if someone was standing five feet away from you with a gun, that you should run. 80% of the people shooting will miss and over 90% won't shoot at all in public. His point was if they are crazy enough to shoot you in public, they would do much worse in private. How do you do this? Use the following:

If someone gets in your car for example in a mall, crash it right away right in the parking lot. Don't drive somewhere else.

Throw your money away and run in the other direction. If they want your money you will be okay. If they didn't, you have a head start.

If you are in a restaurant and someone comes in to hold it up; get up and run out right then and there. Don't wait.

Have a plan of where and when you are going to run with friends. I know those sound crazy but he said it would save your life.

36.title: Consequences
36.verse: Remember this: The person who plants a little will have a small harvest, But the person who plants a lot will have a big harvest.
36.quote: You can do anything in this world if you’re prepared to take the consequences.
36.wisdom:
For everything we do on this earth, and for some things that are done to us, we have consequences. Sometimes the consequences are good and sometimes they are bad. We can be sure that we will have consequences. As an adult, the consequences seem to get more serious, and we are in a position to have the opportunity to create more consequences and impact others as well.

As a child you get scolded by your parents, and if you are really, really bad you may go to military school. As an adult, no one scolds you, but if you are really bad you go to prison.

As a child, if you get in a car accident your parents pay. As an adult, you pay and you may also get to go to prison.

As a child if you win the lottery, your parents have to collect. As an adult, you get to keep the money (minus 40% in taxes)

As a child, if I go to the wrong place I may be spanked or lost. As an adult, if I go to the wrong place I may be raped or murdered.

You get the point. You have watched your dad reap the consequences of my actions; good and bad. You have seen how they have affected you; good and bad. What is really important to remember is that you can’t always see and measure the consequences before the action you take. No matter how well thought out your actions may be you can never really measure all the consequences.

As you make decisions as an adult beware of the consequences good and bad. Take note of the impact your decisions will make.

37.title: Strike One...you're out.
37.verse: A fool always loses his temper, but a wise man holds it back.
37.quote: The worst tempered people I've ever met were the people who knew they were wrong.
37.wisdom:
Don't ever EVER strike a women under any and all circumstances. Walk away. You will find that no one can get under your skin like the women you love. You won't get this till you are at that point but they can. I don't think you have the type of temper that would get to that point. If you find that you do; walk away. Get counseling, get help. Do whatever it takes.

If you ever do it once; you are done. She is gone and more than likely you are in jail.

38.title: Travel
38.verse: For he looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under heaven.
38.quote: For my part, I travel not to go anywhere, but to go.
38.quote_attr: I travel for travel’s sake. The great affair is to move.
38.wisdom:
Robert Louis Stevenson

Travel anywhere and everywhere that you can. Very few things can help you grow to adulthood and continue to grow after that better than traveling. The more different people that you meet and see in their environments the better you can be. There is nothing more powerful than to see how other people, countries, families live to help you understand your experience better.

Your "world" is much smaller than when I grew up. With the internet the world is a much smaller place. Reach out and connect, you will be a better person for it.

39.title: Working Hard
39.verse: A person who does not work hard Is just like someone who destroys things.
39.quote: It is better to wear out, than to rust out.
39.wisdom:
Hard work (effort) requires no intelligence, money, advantage or connections. It just requires commitment and perseverance. Your ability to work hard for school will be a great advantage to you in life. You already know a key secret to success in life; working hard on the important things in your life. Someday you can use this to work hard on your marriage, raising your kids, staying connected to friends, your relationship with Christ just to name a few. You have talent and skills that when put to use with hard work and effort; you can do anything that you strive for.

Make sure that in the coming years you put your effort and priority into your relationship with Christ, your family, your health, your work/school and your friends. They are all important to you. When kept in this priority you will excel.

40.title: Embarrassment
40.verse: For you are my hope; O Lord God, you are my confidence from my youth.
40.quote: If you're never scared or embarrassed or hurt, it means you never take any chances.
40.wisdom:
Almost as destructive as fear, anger or arrogance is embarrassment controlling your life. Embarrassment is an area that I have always struggled with that has been damaging to me. I can’t tell you not to be embarrassed because that it almost impossible. Just don’t let it control you. I can remember many instances where I missed out on doing things because I was embarrassed, or thought I would be embarrassed.

An example would be not asking a girl out because I was afraid to be embarrassed if she said no. It is kind of weird. I was not afraid of rejection but the embarrassment of people knowing I was rejected. Pretty sad, huh!

You know people that do not get embarrassed about anything. Maybe in some areas from your perspective or mine they should be. But should they? They don’t let what other people think affect what you they say, their friends, what they wear, what they like, etc. Seems like a lot less baggage for them than many people carry. The vast majority of feelings of embarrassment are false.

There are so many amazing things you will do and experience in life. Don’t be held back because you fear embarrassment. It is not worth what you will miss.

41.title: Sex
41.verse: *Let us live in the right way, like people who belong to the day,*We should not have wild parties and get drunk. There should be no sexual sin of any kind, no fighting or jealousy.
41.quote: There is nothing like desire for preventing the thing one says from bearing any resemblance to what one has in one’s mind.
41.wisdom:
The standard line is that “Guys are only after ONE thing.” They want sex and they will do anything to get a girl into bed. It is supposed to be different for Christians. I hope so but that is not always the case. You are a Christian guy and you have been told that sex is for marriage. The world tells you different. Is it okay to be a guy that is not after one thing? The answer is yes.

How do you make that happen?

Pick a girl that has the same values and expectations that you do. If you don’t then you will end up being the one to “hold back” and that is a really tough position to be in.

If you do get in a great and strong relationship sex is not the NEXT step to a more mature relationship. It is not a step but a benefit of marriage. If you don’t see it as a “step” to get closer or the next “stage” of a relationship then it won’t be an option. Anyone that tells you that it is necessary, natural or required is lying to you. It is not a necessary step. Sex fogs everything. The desire for sex, is just as foggy as the actual sex in a relationship. Once it occurs, you can’t think straight. You and your sexual purity is the one precious thing you can give to your wife. My expectations are that you want to marry a virgin. Your best hope is to be one yourself.

You don’t need “experience” with sex before marriage. Trust me if you find the right girl; she will be ecstatic that you have “no experience”. There is no upside to being experienced with sex prior to marriage. You are not missing anything by playing the field. All you will do is feel bad later and have to carry the burden of other experience(s) if you have sex before marriage. You will have a stronger marriage if you wait.

42.title: Fear
42.verse: The Lord is my light and the one who saves me. I fear no one. The Lord protects my life I am afraid of no one.
42.quote: Let me assert my firm belief that the only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
42.wisdom:
This is one word that will imprison you if don’t fight it all the time. Be aware of when you are afraid, and as you have heard me say before: “Face your fears.” I am sure that you know people that immediately come to mind when you think of fearful people.

Fear can wreck your life. People fear flying and never travel. People fear trusting people and never have loving relationships. People fear "not having a job" and stay in dead end positions and companies for the rest of their lives.

Don’t let that happen to you. I am sure you are saying that you are not afraid to travel, etc. That is not the point. Don’t let any fear hold you back. Recognize it and see it for what it is. Don’t let fear control your life.

There is one thing to fear and that is God. The bible says, “Wisdom is the Fear of God.” That is a fear you can have.

43.title: Jesus is Lord and Savior
43.verse: Jesus answered: I am the truth, the way, and the life No one comes to the Father except through me.
43.quote: ...that people often say about Him: "I'm ready to accept Jesus as a great moral teacher, but I don't accept His claim to be God." That is the one thing we must not say. A man who was merely a man and said the sort of things Jesus said would not be a great moral teacher. He would either be a lunatic--on a level with the man who says he is a poached egg--or else he would be the Devil of Hell. You must make your choice. Either this man was, and is, the Son of God: or else a madman or something worse. You can shut Him up for a fool, you can spit at Him and kill Him as a demon; or you can fall at His feet and call Him Lord and God. But let us not come with any patronizing nonsense about His being a great human teacher. He has not left that open to us. He did not intend to.
43.wisdom:
The savior part is when you make a decision for Christ. You submit to His will. That is how you get to heaven.

The Lord part is much tougher. That is when you try to live your life to please Him. You do that because you recognize that it is by His sheer grace that you have the many blessings you have today. Your looks, brains, home, family, the fact that you live in the United States, etc. is all by the grace of God. You did nothing to get these; they were given to you. Lordship with Christ means that you recognize the following:

He is bigger than any problem or solution that you may have. Let me say that again: He is bigger than any problem or solution that you may have. Without centering your life on His standards, yours will move. Live by His standards. You do this to please Him. Since He designed everything you can feel confident knowing that "you" are working as designed!

44.title: Work to Live
44.verse: People can work hard using all their wisdom, knowledge and skill but they will die, and The other people will get the things for which they worked. They did not do the work, but they will get everything. This is also unfair and useless.
44.quote: Perpetual devotion to what a man calls his business is only to be sustained by perpetual neglect of many other things.
44.wisdom:
Work to live don’t live to work.

Simple concept. Figure it out early and you will be better for it. Make sure this is the way you live, your future wife lives, and that you teach this to your kids. I have met WAY too many workaholic successful men and women. They are successful but deep down they regret the time they have spent at work. Don’t be like that.

45.title: Love Language
45.verse: It is better to correct someone openly Than to have love and not show it.
45.quote: Love conquers all things; let us too surrender to love.
45.wisdom:
Tell people, show people and remind people that you love them. For the people you love, tell them. This includes your future wife as well as your family. For example, make sure you tell your sister Christine that you love her. Tell your mom you love her; all the time.

Show the people you love that you love them. Everyone responds to a different love language. Harville Hendricks says there are five love languages. They are:

Words of Affirmation: Saying nice things

Gifts: Receiving gifts

Quality time: Spending time with them

Acts of Service: Doing things for them

Physical touch: Hugs, kisses (someday sex with your wife)

Everyone has a different love language. Some have more than one. Find out what they are!

PS; You can tell me you love me too!.

46.title: Arrogance
46.verse: God can’t stomach arrogance or pretense; believe me, he’ll put those upstarts in their place.
46.quote: By my count, more business leaders have failed and derailed because of arrogance than any other character flaw.
46.wisdom:
There seems to be something about the world today that has fallen in love with arrogance. The more successful you are the more accepting it is to be arrogant. Some people say “they are not arrogant”, they are just confident. There is nothing wrong with confidence. We all need it.

The difference is when we begin to think that our own “poop” doesn’t stink. We begin to think we are better than other people. It usually happens in areas that we had no control over from the start.

People are arrogant about where they live, the car they drive, how they look, their talents, how much money they have, etc. At your age, how many of these do you really have control over? I really dislike arrogant people. They just really bug me. Make sure you can see the difference between confidence and arrogance.

Be confident. You have many reasons to be confident. Enjoy that but don’t let it get out of hand and become arrogant.

47.title: Love and Favor
47.verse: The Lord has glory and majesty He has power and beauty in His temple
47.quote: A thing of beauty is a joy forever Its loveliness increases; it will never Pass into nothingness
47.wisdom:
I have wrestled for a very long time with the notion of unconditional love. I am sure you remember us telling you that we love you unconditionally. That means that no matter what you do we will always love you. I love you and always will. I want to make a distinction between love and favor. You have heard the joke that I love you but I don’t necessarily ‘like’ you. There is also "Love the sinner; hate the sin."

Going one step further, I can love you yet you may not have favor with me or your mother. It can also work the opposite as well. This means that for example if you are dis-respectful, not kind and loving to your mom, don’t work to stay connected with your Sister, etc. do poorly in your college grades, get in trouble, etc. I will love you but you will not have favor with me. That might mean you get consequences i.e.. punishment etc. but it also might mean you don’t get insurance for your car. I am sure you get the picture. What I am saying is that love is unconditional; favor is earned. Every day the way you act towards the people you love, your teachers, other adults, etc. you are earning or losing favor.

That may be obvious to you but I wanted you to see the difference. Earn favor from those you love and those you don’t; the rewards will be great and life will be much easier

48.title: Manipulation
48.verse: ...know for sure that you will be punished for your sin.
48.quote: All sin tends to be addictive, and the terminal point of addiction is what is called damnation
48.wisdom:
I know that is a pretty tough bible verse and quote, but this is an area that I really do think you and "everyone else" needs to watch out for. That area is manipulation.

Unfortunately you are very good at it. Sadly, so is everyone else, me included. "We" have learned (I am assuming this is a learned trait.) over many, many years and probably many successful outcomes to manipulate to get our way. Either you do not tell the whole story, add additional items, gauge when and where you communicate information, all with a goal to get your way, keep getting your way or avoid something you do not want. The reason it is so dangerous is that you are good at it and in many instances it works for you.

As you know, the problem is that it creates massive distrust with those whom you love and those that love you. People feel used and misled. The bigger issue is a loss of trust. Trust is something that you earn each and every day. It is like a bank account that you add to or subtract from. As a child, the consequence for manipulation has been loss of “stuff” like phones, computers, sleepovers and car time. All small things in the world of life all handed down by people (your Mom and Dad) who love you unconditionally no matter what you do or how you act.

In an adult world the consequences will be much worse such as loss of job and loss of relationships, and people that you hold dear. . Maybe even more important is that now as an adult you are building a reputation and a witness for all the world to see.

Make it a goal to be bad at manipulation. Quit practicing and get worse at this. The sooner the better.

49.title: Leadership
49.verse: A ruler without wisdom will be cruel, But the one who refuses to take dishonest Money will rule a long time.
49.quote: The person who knows “how” will always have a job. The person who knows “why” will always be his boss.
49.wisdom:
Companies rot from the top down. So do countries, towns and families. Leadership is everything. Having a bad leader is disastrous all the way around. Spiritually the provocative question is “Who leads your life, you or Jesus? If it is you, you are in trouble. If it is Christ; then there is hope for you.

Individually the question becomes whom are you leading today? Where are you leading them? Where are you going? You will have many opportunities to lead in the coming years. You have all the natural skills necessary to be a leader. I have heard you say (maybe jokingly or not) that you don’t want to be leader. You will be a leader of your family, friends or business some day. I am telling you that while the leader has more responsibility they have the best job, best pay, best perks, best schedule. Everyone else gets second best.

A president was once asked what he thought of his job at the company. After some thought he said the following: “ It is not perfect by a long shot. However when I look around at all the other jobs in the company, this is by far the best one…” Leaders are held to a higher standard. As an adult you will be called upon to lead. Step up and lead. You have all the skills and talent necessary. Don’t waste them.

Leadership is needed. You have the capability. Don’t pass it up.

50.title: New Rules
50.verse: He is strong and respected by the people He looks forward to the future with joy.
50.quote: I have seen the future and it works.
50.wisdom:
Welcome to Being an Adult. This is you are a not a kid anymore lingo. We love you and always want you around but now that you are 18; you have more choices. Note: Just because you have the choice does not necessarily make it a good one...

**KEVIN** 18TH BIRTHDAY CHANGES

Old requirements No vegetable requirements No chores No vacation or holiday requirements

You are always welcome at our house. (Now that you are 18; you are "free" if you want to be.) Anytime. For a day, week, month, years...

When we take a vacation, you are always welcome to join us for the vacation we are on. Note: We will always pay for the entire vacation if you take the entire vacation with us. <mark>(Example: We go to Nanny and Grandpa’s for a week this summer. I will pay for you to come with us for the week. If you decide you only want to come for three days then you pay your own airfare.)</mark>

I will always include you in the planning so you can make the vacation with us if you want.

New Requirements

If you come to visit/live, come because you want to be with us and don’t be angry about it. Examples of ways you show us you want to be with us: Eat some meals with us, talk with us, buys us dinner/lunch etc., go to the store or Starbucks with us, watch TV or a movie with us, etc.

You have no chores but come with an attitude to want to participate and help out. If when you come you only take, take, take and never give, you will wear out your welcome.

If you are staying with us and we go to church, we expect you to join with us.

If you stay with us, you will have a curfew that will go to 12:00pm unless rarely delayed for some unique reason.

More financial details to follow.

51.title: Being An Adult
51.verse: Don’t stop listening to correction my child, Or you will forget what you have already learned.
51.quote: The future...something which everyone reaches at The rate of sixty minutes and hour, whatever he does, whoever he is.
51.wisdom:
CONGRATULATIONS!

You are now once again the youngest as in the youngest adult there can be at 18 years of age. Just when you had made it to the top, you are right back at the beginning again. I am so very proud of you. 18 years of age and you have your entire life ahead of you to LIVE.

Live it well and live it as it should be because it is the only one you will ever have on this Earth. One of the ways you prepare for eternity is by living a full life here. I hope that one or two of the things I had to tell you will be of value to you now that you are 18. Take the very best and worst of all those around you, mix it in with the very best and worst of yourself these past 18 years and match it up against the Bible for a truth test and GO FOR IT.

You have such flexibility and such wide opportunity ahead. You can do so much. I saw a license plate the other day that said: If you are living as if there is not a God…you had better be right. That is true but it should read just the opposite. If you are living as if there is a God; you are right and ENJOY all that He has given you. You really have been given quite a bit in your first 18 years. You are blessed; you really are. You have so much still ahead of you. Don’t be afraid to make a mistake. Don’t be fearful. You are loved, cherished, prayed for, appreciated, approved of, accepted just the way you are.

My love for you is unconditional. It always has been and always will be. You already have done enough for me to love you with all my heart just by being born. You are precious, unique, special, loved, appreciated, significant, valuable, cherished and wanted. I am so very impressed with you. You have such talent, beauty, creativity, humor, confidence and intelligence. I have said this before…You are perfectly imperfect.

The problem is that it now means that I have a son that is 18 years of age and I think I am too young to have a son that old. You have given me an unbelievable 18 years. They have not all been perfect but at the same time, I feel incredibly proud to be your Dad.

52.title: Praying
52.verse: Lord hear my prayer; listen to my cry for mercy. Answer me because you are loyal and good.
52.quote: One single grateful thought raised to heaven is the most perfect prayer.
52.wisdom:
There is really one subject left that I need to share with you. It isn’t the 52nd most important one; it is just the last one. I wanted to share with you how important it is for you to pray for everything that you do. I really believe that we all need “prayer cover.” This means that we need people praying for us, and we need to be praying for others and ourselves.

Since the day I became a Christian, I have prayed for you unceasingly. It makes a difference and I want to encourage you to bring your challenges, hopes and dreams to God. Life is exciting and wonderful, but it is also very hard. You can’t do it on your own, and you shouldn’t try. Recognize your position, and recognize that it is by the grace of God we exist and breathe. It is easy to ask because He is worth asking.

I have enjoyed sharing these ideas with you. I also enjoy praying for you. I request that you pray for me as well. I need it. It is more important than sending me a birthday card or calling me on Father’s Day.

Thank you for the past 18 years. God willing we will have many, many more years together.
